fields.label: Repeatable
fields.name: repeatable
fields.description: Uncheck if this can only happen once per match

fields.label: Repeatable Interval (seconds)
fields.name: repeatable_interval
fields.description: Seconds until this can happen again (if repeatable)

fields.label: Priority
fields.name: priority
fields.description: Integer priority (default 0). Higher values take precedence over lower ones when multiple triggers fire simultaneously. A higher-priority trigger can interrupt a lower-priority sound/image that is marked as interruptable.

fields.label: Interruptable
fields.name: interruptable
fields.description: Check to allow a higher-priority trigger to cut this one short. Uncheck to protect this trigger's audio/image from being interrupted by anything except a strictly higher-priority trigger.

fields.label: Conditions (JS)
fields.name: conditions
fields.description: A CSV of valid JS anonymous functions that return true when the trigger should fire. Each function will be called with (event) parameters.

fields.label: Actions (JS)
fields.name: actions
fields.description: A CSV of valid JS anonymous functions that are called upon trigger firing. Each function will be called with (event) parameters. Can be empty.

fields.label: Image URL
fields.name: image_src
fields.description: An optional image to show when this trigger fires. Can be left blank. Use a transparent gif for best effect if streaming.
